violations.text: Eggs were observed held at (54) degrees Fahrenheit in new refrigerator at time of inspection. Per interview of PIC refrigerator breaker went off and was turned on 20 mins prior to inspection. PIC moved eggs and other TCS foods to refrigerator in the back room to cool rapidly. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Proper cold holding reviewed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/21/2026

The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was blocked by (chemical bottle). PIC relocated chemical bottle to designated area. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

(Several foods) was observed held at (51-62) degrees Fahrenheit. PIC did a voluntary disposal at time of inspection. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

There is insufficient refrigeration equipment/capacity to maintain a temperature of 41 degrees or below. Establishment is using a residential refrigerator must obtain commercial unit. New Violation. Correct By: 07/21/2026
Refrigerator located in the (bar) area was not in good repair. Equipment shall be maintained in good repair/or in need of adjustment. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

The countertops at the (bar) are constructed of (wood) which is not durable, easily cleanable, or non-absorbent. Observed countertops covers peeling at time of inspection. The materials must be durable, easily cleanable and nonabsorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing areas, and toilet rooms. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the (countertop) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 10/30/2024
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was lacking paper towels. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/23/2024

Bowls are being used as scoops in containers of ice. Utensils used to dispense non-time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as sugar and flour must be stored in the food item with their handles above the top of the food within the container. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/23/2024
Water was observed in blender bowls. After cleaning and sanitizing equipment and utensils must be air dried. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/23/2024
Prep table located in the bar area was not in good repair, observed plastic peeling and exposed wood. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 02/21/2022

The facility is lacking a mop sink. At least one mop sink or one curbed cleaning facility equipped with a floor drain must be provided and conveniently located for the cleaning of mops or similar wet floor cleaning tools and for the disposal of mop water and similar liquid waste. New Violation. Correct By: 11/06/2024

The floor and wall junctures in the ware washing area do not have coving. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 02/21/2022

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the back area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 02/21/2022
